summary: Castor Maritime Inc., a NASDAQ-listed Cyprus-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, attaching a press release reporting second-quarter and first-half 2026 results. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation. Q2 net income was $26.8 million, or $1.70 per basic share, on total vessel revenues of $14.9 million and services revenue of $10.7 million; six-month net income reached $96.0 million, or $6.35 per basic share. Cash and restricted cash totaled $109.4 million at June 30, 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated.
